runs.note: Biweekly scan, 25 Oct 2026. Ten entries, three full dossiers. Top three: cool-water face washing (TRY, free but small and sponsor-linked), a peptide serum for laser and microneedling aftercare (WATCH, missed its primary endpoint, no pigment advantage), and topical PDRN versus retinol (WATCH, supplier-linked, no vehicle arm). Hair and scalp: a completed CCCA drug trial in adults of African descent (registry only) and a curl shampoo (SKIP). Coverage limit: registries and regulators were largely reached only through search results because direct fetches of listed addresses were refused when unattended; see the appendix in the Markdown batch. The three earlier Watch items were re-searched: no change found.

# [RUN APPENDIX] Coverage, source test and checks, 2026-10-25

## Source test (real calls this run; nothing is claimed as covered without one)
Unattended note: WebFetch refused every URL that was only listed in the task prompt (error PROVENANCE_REQUIRED, "permission request not answered"), but fetched pages whose URLs had come back from a WebSearch result. So registries and regulators were reached through site-scoped WebSearch (titles and URLs only) and then fetched where a result URL was returned.

|---|---|---|

| ClinicalTrials.gov (MCP) | reached | 2 searches (skin, alopecia); 1 full record read (NCT07843732) |

## Lane coverage checklist
- HPA axis / nervous system: PubMed searched 3 ways (stress and skin interventions; ashwagandha, vagus nerve or HRV with skin; psychodermatology RCTs). Results were mostly off-topic; one lead worth listing (hair cortisol, entry 7). Otherwise searched, nothing worth listing.
- Black and melanin-rich skin: PubMed (skin of colour trials), ClinicalTrials.gov, hair and scalp searches. Entries: CCCA registry, toner-with-hydroquinone safety study, device review.
- Tools and devices: PubMed (energy devices, LED and microcurrent). Entries: device review, LED systematic review. Microcurrent: searched, nothing worth listing.
- Clinic and medspa incl. Korean clinics: PubMed (PDRN, exosome, microneedling, RF, laser in Asian skin), one WebSearch on new Korean clinic skin-booster launches (titles only, nothing opened). Entries: peptide aftercare serum, PDRN. Platelet-rich plasma for melasma (photothermal vs conventional PRP, 26 women, both arms PRP, no difference in mMASI) was read at abstract level and not listed.
- Hair and scalp / 3C-4A-4B hair products: PubMed x3, ClinicalTrials.gov (alopecia), WebSearch (curl and bond products). Entries: CCCA registry, curl shampoo. Hair-loss registry hits that were pharmaceutical (alopecia areata JAK programmes) were not listed.
- Goals-aligned science: PDRN, retinal plus azelaic acid, toner study.
- Entropy wildcard: hair as a cortisol record (entry 7), plus cool-water cleansing as a zero-cost behaviour change.
- Rx / OTC / clinical: CCCA registry, retinal plus azelaic acid, hydroquinone-combination safety study. Not listed: a trade-press supplier claim (Debut's DermCeutical PNar, Premium Beauty News, 19 Sep 2026: 0.45% use level, claimed 97% improved over 12 weeks, no sample size or design given; labelled supplier marketing).

## Watch re-check (prior Watch items)
- Mevalonolactone: PubMed re-searched on 25 Oct 2026. No new skin trial or paper found. No change found.
- Thiamidol: PubMed re-searched. The multi-country real-world regimen study is already in the earlier entry. A Delphi consensus on melasma treatment in vitiligo surfaced (Pigment Cell Melanoma Res, 2026) but is not efficacy data. No change found.
- Scalp seborrheic dermatitis and androgenetic alopecia framework: PubMed re-searched. Only the already-cited review surfaced. No change found.

## Build facts
Tailwind compiled via npx (tailwindcss 3.4.17; no cached-CSS fallback message was printed). RDKit was not installed and was not needed: no ingredient structure drawing was made this run. Build output: 13 entries total (10 new), site/index.html about 300 KB.

runs.note: Prototype run, extended. Three entries: the mevalonolactone dossier, a thiamidol dossier (ingredient lists and prices read from retailer pages, full text read for the main trial), and a scalp-condition framework (triage). Built before the scheduled scan starts on 25 October, so coverage is narrow.

safetyWatch.text: RELLET Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydrating Spray (300 ml pressurized) recalled on 5 Aug 2026 for missing mandatory hazard labelling; about 1,223 units sold March to July 2026.

A whipped tallow face, body and hair product was recalled on 21 Jan 2026 because methyl eugenol exceeded the Cosmetic Ingredient Hotlist limit (earlier in the year, listed as an example of a botanical-extract limit failure).

TGA published a safety review of the sunscreen filter 4-methylbenzylidene camphor (4-MBC), dated July 2026 and filed September 2026. I could not read it (the file was blocked to automated fetching), so its conclusion is unknown.

safetyNote: Reached: two Health Canada recall pages (via search results), the EU SCCS opinions page (newest listed opinion 30 Apr 2026, which may be behind), and TGA search listings. Not reached: FDA recall listings (search returned guidance pages only), Korea MFDS, Japan PMDA. Direct fetches of the regulator landing pages were refused when unattended. This is not a clean bill of health.
